items.title: Anthropic to debut amid security worries and SpaceX to finance GPU rentals
items.summary:
Deirdre Bosa discusses Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) expected IPO to launch amid multiple security worries, SpaceX (SPCX) financing GPU rentals, and getting around the AI bottleneck.

Deirdre Bosa then sits down with Micron (MU) president and CTO Scott J. DeBoer to discuss the chip stock sell-off, Washington putting the screws to China in the AI trade, and TSMC's (TSM) potential move into memory.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

items.title: Micron President on the AI gap: "China is far behind in high-bandwidth memory"
items.summary: Micron (MU) President and Chief Technology and Products Officer, Scott J. DeBoer, joins Deirdre Bosa on Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa Live to o discuss the memory gap in the global AI chip race and the competitive nature of the memory business.

items.title: Memory supply constraints will be even 'tighter' in 2027: Micron CTO
items.summary: Micron (MU) president and CTO Scott DeBoer sits down with Deirdre Bosa to discuss his outlook on memory supply versus demand in the year ahead.

items.title: Is Broadcom “a Momentum Stock Wearing a Value Costume”? Its December 9 Report Will Tell
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBroadcom’s revenue rose 86% last quarter, and management expects AI revenue to double to about $115 billion in fiscal 2027. One investor questions Broadcom’s roughly 45x trailing GAAP multiple, but on adjusted earnings it trades at 36x trailing and 20x forward.

items.title: Can Apple Grow Cash Flow 17% a Year? That’s What Its Record Price Implies
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOne investor’s reverse DCF finds Apple’s near-record price needs 16. 9% annual free cash flow growth for 10 years, three times its five-year revenue growth.

items.title: Global chip stocks rally as Anthropic’s record IPO boosts confidence in AI trade
items.summary: Investing.com -- Global semiconductor stocks rallied Thursday after Anthropic priced the largest initial public offering (IPO) on record, boosting confidence in the AI trade.
